original_declared_posterior_support: [0,5]; mass above 5 is zero by this prior definition
uncertified_tail_scope: the posterior from the same likelihood under a specified wider prior, before conditioning on [0,5]
interpretation_of_posterior_beyond_decla: no wider-prior posterior tail was observed or independently certified; this does not deny the exact support of the currently declared posterior
effect_on_existing_results: fixed-prior empirical readouts retain their conditional interpretation; no new broader-prior cosmological result or material claim revision is adopted
